coverage: Whole group · manufacturing and marketing of luggage and bags
definition: Group result after operating costs, financing costs, exceptional gains and costs, and tax. The negative value is a loss.
location: Statement of audited financial results, consolidated year columns ended 31 March 2026 and 2025, rows 1 and 3–7 and notes 3, 4 and 6.
notes: The group’s loss before exceptional items and tax was ₹416.20 crore. Net exceptional income of ₹78.18 crore included a sale of assets outside the core business and net insurance and fire items. There is one reported business segment, so the source gives no profit by brand or bag.
insight: Group sales fell and losses widened from the previous year. Read the net gain from exceptional items separately from regular luggage sales and costs.
